title: 1st trial journalist Ahmad Fauzi
paragraphs: The 1st trial for defamation against Central Javanist journalists has now been made, Ahmad Fauzi.

According to the charges, Ahmad Fauzi published a story about a wild pick-up at the port on November 17, 2025, which the prosecutor judged to accuse someone of doing something to ruin the good name of someone.
The trial was held at the Semarang State Court on February 9, 2026, where the panel of judges delayed the trial until March 2, 2026.
In the matter of Ahmad Fauzi, the attorneys of the Wicaksono Mining Law say the witnesses filed by the defense are not permitted to give a statement.
Ahmad Fauzi worked as a Central Javanese journalist now in Semarang, an alliance of journalists claiming to monitor the course of the trial.
The prosecution will read the charges to the next trial Ahmad Fauzi was not arrested during the trial.
